generalNotes: HAND-CURATED. A pipeline regenerator must never touch this file, and tools/ must never delete it - the data/ rebuild on 2026-08-31 wiped it once already. Every key below is an exact record key from data/perks.json, resolved by SEARCHING perks.json by display name, not from memory, because the keys are wildly inconsistent (some are readable, some are patch codes like 'K26P02', and several names no longer match their key at all: 'Unbreakable' is keyed SelfSufficient, 'Overcharge' is GeneratorOvercharge, 'Franklin's Demise' is FranklinsLoss, 'Cruel Limits' is CruelConfinement, 'Shattered Hope' is BoonDestroyer, 'Knock Out' is InTheDark, 'Hex: No One Escapes Death' is No_One_Escapes_Death). WEIGHTS 1-5: 5 = defines the archetype, the build is not that archetype without it; 4 = core, you take it unless you have a reason not to; 3 = solid, earns a slot in most versions; 2 = situational, wants a map, a killer, or a teammate to be worth it; 1 = filler, better than an empty slot. Weights are judged against the SHIPPED DESCRIPTION in perks.json, not against remembered patch history - several perks read very differently now than they did at release. Two that bit during curation: Dead Hard now only arms after an unhook and grants 0.5s of Endurance, so it is weighted as an anti-tunnel tool (4) rather than a chase tool (3); and the record named 'Knock Out' (key InTheDark) ships a pallet-drop Hindered effect, nothing like the classic aura-suppression perk, so it is weighted as a low chase perk and appears in no slugging archetype. A perk may appear in several archetypes at different weights - that is intended, it is how the generator produces different builds from overlapping pools. Every archetype carries at least 15 weighted perks so the spice slider has real variance to work with, and at least one weight-5 anchor so a generated build always has a spine.

looping.name: Looping
looping.blurb: Win the chase. Read the tile, know where the next pallet is, and buy your team a whole generator every time the killer commits to you.

genrush.name: Gen Rush
genrush.blurb: Generators are the win condition. Repair faster, repair together, and turn every skill check into progress the killer cannot take back.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.blurb: Never be found. Break every tracking tool the killer brought - auras, scratch marks, blood, sound - and let the chase happen to somebody else.

antitunnel.name: Anti-Tunnel
antitunnel.blurb: Survive the hook. Everything here buys time in the twenty seconds after an unhook, when a tunnelling killer is trying to take you out of the game entirely.

altruism.name: Healer
altruism.blurb: Keep the team standing. Fast heals, heals that cost you nothing, and the ability to get somebody off a hook and back into the game before the killer turns around.

info.name: Information
info.blurb: Play with the lights on. See your team, see the killer, see the hook - and make every decision on facts instead of guesses.

endgame.name: Endgame
endgame.blurb: Five gens done, everything to play for. Speed through the gates, survive the killer's last stand, and drag somebody out with you.

beginner.name: Balanced Beginner
beginner.blurb: One of everything. A build that teaches the game: it shows you the map, shows you your team, gets you off a hook alive, and still finishes generators.

slowdown.name: Slowdown
slowdown.blurb: The match is a clock. Block generators, blow them up, and make the survivors spend the same progress three times before it ever counts.

chase.name: Chase
chase.blurb: End loops early. Take the window away, eat the pallet stun, and close the distance the tile was supposed to give them.

killerinfo.name: Tracking
killerinfo.blurb: Never walk an empty loop. Aura reads, scream reveals and noise alerts, so every patrol goes straight to a survivor instead of hunting for one.

hex.name: Hex
hex.blurb: High risk, high ceiling. Stack totems so the survivors have to go find them - and make the cleanse cost them more than leaving it lit.

killerendgame.name: Endgame
killerendgame.blurb: Lose the gens, win the game. Lock the doors, make the exit gate take forever, and turn the last thirty seconds into free kills.

killerstealth.name: Ambush
killerstealth.blurb: Arrive without a heartbeat. Undetectable windows and terror-radius tricks so the first thing they hear is the hit.

snowball.name: Snowball
snowball.blurb: Turn one down into three. Carry pressure, exposed windows and hook-chaining value so the first mistake the team makes is the last one.

debuff.name: Attrition
debuff.blurb: Make being injured permanent. Anti-heal, exhaustion and hindrance stack until the team cannot afford to reset and cannot afford not to.

synergies.note: Undying gives Ruin a second totem to burn through.
Every totem they cleanse becomes a Pentimento rekindle.
Plaything forces cleanses; Pentimento charges off them.
Spirit Fury breaks the pallet, Enduring cuts the stun.
Corrupt herds them together; Lethal shows you where.
Pain Res kicks the best gen, Dead Man's blocks whatever they let go.
Agitation extends the carry, Starstruck exposes everyone near it.
No Way Out delays the gate long enough for Blood Warden to land.
Overcharge ramps the regression, Call of Brine multiplies it.
Hyperfocus stacks while Prove Thyself is already speeding the repair.
Stake Out turns good checks into greats, which is what Hyperfocus counts.
The classic anti-tunnel pair: Endurance first, stun second.
No sound, no blood, no scratch marks - a full injured reset.
Both multiply the same post-unhook heal.
Adrenaline heals you at the buzzer, Hope carries you to the gate.
Open-Handed pushes Bond's range out to most of the map.
Vigil cuts the Exhausted timer so Sprint Burst comes back sooner.
Windows shows the tile, Five Moves Ahead shows the two you should use.
Two stacked Mangled/Hemorrhage sources make a heal a losing trade.
Both scale off the same injured, un-reset team.
A smaller terror radius plus Undetectable at 70% is a free hit.
Recover and crawl at once, then pick yourself up.
Small Game finds the totem, Counterforce clears the rest fast.
Between them you can see the whole team most of the match.
